write_tools.append_file: WRITES: adds text at the end of a file in /work (creates it when missing)
write_tools.apply_patch: WRITES: applies a unified diff to a file in /work (all hunks or nothing)
write_tools.copy: WRITES: copies a file or folder into /work (an existing file replaced only with overwrite=true)
write_tools.delete: WRITES: deletes a file, link or folder in /work (moved into /work/.trash unless FILES_TRASH=0)
write_tools.delete_lines: WRITES: deletes a range of lines of a file in /work
write_tools.edit_file: WRITES: replaces one exact piece of text in a file in /work (or every occurrence with replace_all)
write_tools.insert_lines: WRITES: inserts lines into a file in /work
write_tools.move: WRITES: moves or renames a file, link or folder in /work (an existing file replaced only with overwrite=true)
write_tools.write_file: WRITES: creates or replaces a whole file in /work (an existing one only with expected_sha256 or overwrite=true)
write_tools.write_markdown: WRITES: creates or replaces a Markdown file in /work after repairing it (dry_run=true writes nothing)
